purpose: Candidate pretraining sources for HYDRA Base (proprietary weights). Every source is checked against hydra/training/base_data_policy.py by tests/test_base_sources.py. 'license' is the policy id that applies to the documents kept after 'filter'.

admitted.name: Common Corpus (PleIAs), filtered
admitted.filter: keep rows whose per-document 'license' is public domain, CC0, CC-BY, MIT or Apache; drop CC-BY-SA (Wikipedia, Stack Exchange in OpenWeb) and anything else
admitted.size: 2.27T tokens in total, ~46.5B Spanish before filtering
admitted.notes: Per-document licence metadata; collections OpenCulture, OpenGovernment, OpenScience (OpenAlex), OpenSource. Central source for general Spanish text without Wikipedia.

admitted.name: BOE legislación consolidada
admitted.notes: Already downloading to data/sources/boe. Includes drone (UAS), industrial safety and education regulation.

admitted.name: EUR-Lex (Spanish versions)
admitted.filter: legal acts in force, Spanish language, bulk data dump (EU Login required)
admitted.size: all EU acts in force per language
admitted.notes: Covers the Machinery Regulation, drone rules (EU 2019/947), REACH chemicals regulation.

admitted.name: datos.gob.es and regional open data portals
admitted.filter: text datasets only; keep each portal's citation
admitted.notes: General reuse conditions are substantially equivalent to CC BY 4.0.

admitted.name: OpenStax en español (Química 2ed, Física universitaria, etc.)
admitted.filter: Spanish textbooks only; attribution to OpenStax / Rice University; no use of the OpenStax trademark
admitted.notes: Reviewed, tested teaching material with exercises and solutions.

admitted.name: SciELO (CC BY articles)
admitted.filter: per-article licence: keep CC BY only, drop CC BY-NC and older licences

admitted.name: US patents (allenai/us-patents; HUPD)
admitted.filter: select by CPC: B25J (robots), B33Y (additive manufacturing / 3D printing), B64U and B64C (drones/UAV), G05B (control and automation), C07-C08 (chemistry); exclude drawings
admitted.notes: Expert-written technical descriptions; spanish versions can be produced by an Apache-2.0/MIT teacher as hydra-generated data.

admitted.name: Common Pile stackv2_edu (permissive code)
admitted.filter: scripts/fetch_stackv2_python_sample.py keeps license_type=permissive; extend to C/C++ (embedded, ROS, firmware) with the same filter
admitted.size: shards 75-84 Python; other languages in other shards
admitted.notes: PX4 (BSD-3) and ROS packages (BSD/Apache) fit; keep per-file attribution.

admitted.name: Common Pile v0.1 (filtered)
admitted.filter: per-document licence metadata: drop CC BY-SA (wikis, Stack Exchange) and other licences outside the policy
admitted.notes: Each document carries explicit licence metadata.

admitted.name: PX4 User Guide
admitted.filter: documentation only (firmware code is BSD-3 and comes through the code source)
admitted.notes: Reviewed documentation of a widely used autopilot.

admitted.name: Cosmopedia (HuggingFaceTB)
admitted.filter: synthetic textbooks; teacher Mixtral-8x7B is Apache-2.0; drop seeds from non-admitted sources if traceable
admitted.notes: Synthetic, so it is a supplement, not a substitute for reviewed sources.

rejected.name: CorpusNÓS (Galician)
rejected.reason: most subcorpora CC BY-SA; TED2020 is CC BY-NC-ND

rejected.name: FineWeb / FineWeb-2 / FineWeb-Edu
rejected.reason: licence covers the compilation, not the web texts

rejected.name: CulturaX / OSCAR / mC4
rejected.reason: licence covers the compilation, not the web texts

pending_review.name: PubChem
pending_review.reason: NCBI data is largely public domain but depositor records can carry their own terms; admit only records with an explicit permissive licence

pending_review.name: ROS 2 documentation
pending_review.reason: licence of docs.ros.org not confirmed in this review

pending_review.name: Spanish university open textbooks
pending_review.reason: licences vary by publisher (CC BY vs CC BY-NC-SA); admit per title
